BETA Close X Ninety One PLC has repurchased a total of 1,504,094 ordinary shares between June 22, 2026, and June 26, 2026, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. The purchases were executed through J.P. Morgan Securities plc, with the lowest price paid per share being GBp 204.20 and the highest at GBp 218.20, resulting in a volume-weighted average price of GBp 209.53. The company has stated its intention to cancel these repurchased shares. Since June 3, 2026, Ninety One has bought back a cumulative 3,133,319 shares for a total cost of £6,735,782.86. Following these transactions, the company holds no shares in treasury, and its total issued ordinary shares stand at 665,539,081.
